title: Worse than Dying
excerpt: John Shelby Spong is famous for saying “Christianity must change or die.” There’s a lot of truth to that. But I’m actually worried about something worse than Christianity dying. I’m worried about Christianity killing. – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016) Tour…
body:
John Shelby Spong is famous for saying “Christianity must change or die.” There’s a lot of truth to that. But I’m actually worried about something worse than Christianity dying. I’m worried about Christianity killing.

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016)
